title: Answer: a self is a subject of experience, made by combination or by emergence

statements.text: A subject of experience is simply a thing there is something it is like to be. Experience needs a subject, and a human subject is either grounded in bonded micro-subjects, an aspect of the cosmic subject, or, on hybrid cosmopsychism, a new subject that emerges and inherits part of the universe’s experience.

sources.quote: By 'subject of experience' I simply mean a thing that is phenomenally conscious
'experience is impossible without an experiencer', a subject of experience
